name: Our Day!
source:
When Melody discovers her friend and coworker Coco's birthday is coming up, she plans a super special surprise party for her!  But something throws a wrench in her plans - and possibly her friendship. Can Melody and Coco stay friends?

[From [url=https://wingberry.itch.io/our-day]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当Melody发现她的朋友兼同事Coco的生日即将到来时，她为她准备了一个超级特别的惊喜派对！但有些事情打乱了她的计划——也可能打乱了她的友谊。Melody和Coco还能保持朋友关系吗？

[来自[url=https://wingberry.itch.io/our-day]Itch.io[/url]]
